cochlea.definition: The little spiral inside your ear that turns vibrations into nerve signals.
cochlea.example: The cochlea changes the movement of your eardrum into signals.

endangered.definition: An animal that is in danger of disappearing for ever, because there are so few left.
endangered.example: The giant panda is endangered. We must protect it.

mon_interest.definition: The price of borrowing money, charged as a percentage of what you still owe.
mon_interest.example: At 2 % a year on a debt of 1 000 $, the interest for the year is 20 $.
